## `client.comments`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.discussion.CommentsManager`.

Comments on an item (`@comments`).

### `client.comments.create`

Add a comment, or a reply to a comment.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.discussion.CommentsManager.create`.

Calls `POST /news/release-6-2/@comments` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/comments.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.comments.create("/news/release-6-2", "Great news!")
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
POST /Plone/++api++/news/release-6-2/@comments HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

{
  "text": "Great news!"
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/news/release-6-2/@comments -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"text":"Great news!"}'
```
````
`````

The site answers `204`, and the method returns `None`.
